about:
I am Alek, the founder of OSTM LTD. I am a developer with a particular interest in Unity, gameplay programming and web development.

My projects include a branching dialogue system, development tools, collision geometry and a node based vehicle movement system.

Along with Unity, I work with HTML, CSS and JS to build websites and connect systems. I enjoy solving technical problems and making my work easier for other developers to use.

contact.title: Let’s build something.
contact.description: Interested in my work or want to discuss a development opportunity? Get in touch.

projects.title: Unity Dialogue System
projects.description: A branching dialogue system built on xNode, separated from its original game into a reusable Unity project.
projects.contribution: C# dialogue functionality, node presentation improvements, demonstration graphs and developer documentation.

projects.title: Unity Dev Console System
projects.thumbnailAlt: Unity Dev Console showing available commands
projects.description: An in-game development console with separate command components and help information generated from registered commands.
projects.contribution: Command registration, reusable command components, custom command creation tools and setup documentation.

projects.title: 3D Collider Tool
projects.thumbnailAlt: Custom collider points and generated collision mesh
projects.description: A Unity editor tool for creating custom convex collision shapes by adding, removing and moving points.
projects.contribution: Point editing, convex hull generation, automatic MeshCollider updates, validation and multiple-point selection.

projects.title: Node Based Vehicle Movement
projects.thumbnailAlt: A vehicle following a node-based route
projects.description: A configurable vehicle movement prototype that follows ordered route nodes, with adjustable movement and turning settings.
projects.contribution: Route management, editor-controlled node creation and removal, undo support and vehicle movement.

projects.title: OSTM Radio
projects.description: I am the proud owner of OSTM Radio, radio station that I created from scratch. From developing a website to building and managing servers, and from curating the perfect playlist to editing music, I'm involved in every aspect of the station. Plus, I'm always working hard to keep our followers in the loop by writing awesome blog posts and updating our social media accounts every couple of days. It's a lot of work, but I love every minute of it!
projects.contribution: Founded and developed OSTM Radio, its website and servers. Managed the technical infrastructure, prepared audio and contribute to the radio stations content and operations.

projects.title: The UNRELATED Podcast
projects.description: One of the most exciting projects I've had the chance to work on was the creation of "The UNRELATED Podcast", which my college friends and I produced to be played on my radio station, OSTM Radio. Over the course of two seasons, we discussed the latest news and events happening around the world, and had some great conversations and debates along the way. It was a real team effort, and I loved being a part of something so creative and engaging. I'm proud of what we achieved with the podcast, and I'm looking forward to seeing where it might go in the future.
projects.contribution: Handled the technical production, including setting up recording software, coordinating recording times, editing audio and uploading episodes for broadcast.

projects.title: The Story of Kate Webster
projects.thumbnailAlt: The Story of Kate Webster Logo
projects.description: As part of a second-year university project, I had the opportunity to work on The Story of Kate Webster, a short narrative-driven game built in Unity. You play as Kate Webster, making choices through a branching dialogue system that influences the story's outcome. I was the lead programmer in a group of three, responsible for coding the entire game. It was challenging deciding what features to prioritize in a short development window, but I’m really proud of what I achieved.
projects.contribution: Lead programmer in Unity using C#. Created the branching dialogue system and implemented the gameplay functionality, prioritising features in a short development time.

projects.title: Wiinite
projects.description: Wiinite started as a fun project after I was inspired by a video imagining what Fortnite would look like if it was made on the Nintendo Wii. I loved the concept so much that I decided to build my own version! The journey wasn’t easy — importing the Wuhu Island map, fixing texture issues, adding characters, and setting up emotes all had their challenges. But after a lot of trial, error, and creativity, I brought Wiinite to life. This project taught me so much about problem-solving and game development. If you want to see more about the project and its development journey, I made two videos on my YouTube channel explaining everything!
projects.contribution: Developed the Unity prototype, integrating the Wuhu island map, adding characters, implemented emotes.
projects.moreLabel: Why Did I Make This... - YouTube

projects.title: The Dark Lord's Reign
projects.description: I'm excited to share that I've written a book called The Dark Lord's Reign, an epic tale set in the depths of Hell. The story follows Lucifer, the fallen angel, as he leads a coven of powerful witches on a dangerous mission to face the upcoming war against the souls of Hell. The journey is perilous, and the witches will have to push the boundaries of their beliefs and test the limits of their powers to defeat their enemies and secure their place in the underworld. With the fate of Hell hanging in the balance, Lucifer and his allies must come together to harness the power of the Grand Hall of Arcane and unleash the full extent of their magic against their foes. But with enemies at every turn and the souls of Hell determined to reign supreme, the battle won't be easy. Will they be able to overcome the challenges and emerge victorious, or will the souls of Hell succeed in their quest for ultimate power? The Dark Lord's Reign is a thrilling and action-packed adventure that I'm proud to have written and hope you enjoy reading.

projects.title: The Late Night
projects.description: During my time in college, I had the chance to take part in a fun project where we had one week to create a game based on the theme "Winter Wonderland". I teamed up with two other classmates, and my role was to program the entire game and work within the Unity game engine. We put our heads together and worked hard, and it paid off when our game scored first place in the rankings! It was an incredible feeling to see our game come to life and to know that our hard work and creativity had paid off.
projects.contribution: Programmed the game in Unity as part of a small team, turning the brief into a playable game within one week.

projects.title: TFGM Tram Board
projects.description: In October 2023, I created a tram board to mimic the live board seen on tram stops in Manchester. This was a passion project as I love the trams and I liked the idea of being able to see and hear the announcements live.
projects.contribution: Developed a web based tram information board, integrating the live tram data and audio announcements to recreate the official Manchester tram stops.

projects.title: Structurefy
projects.description: Structurefy is a simple but useful tool I built during my second year at university. It's a Unity editor extension that automatically generates a folder structure at the start of any new Unity project, based on a config file. No more creating folders by hand! While it wasn’t the most complicated thing I've made, it definitely saves time.

projects.title: Monkey Runner
projects.description: During the 2022 half term, I took on a personal project that I'm super excited about: creating a new mobile game for both Android and IOS users. From start to finish, I was the one coming up with all the ideas, writing every line of code, and troubleshooting any issues that cropped up along the way. It was definitely a challenge, but I love seeing my vision come to life, and I can't wait to share it with the world!

projects.title: Time Travel Game
projects.description: The Time Travel Game was a group project I worked on during my time at university. I was one of the programmers, helping to build gameplay systems and integrate mechanics. Although I had to leave the project early, it was still a valuable learning experience about collaboration and game production.

projects.title: Glitterbeam Radio - Presenter
projects.description: It was a huge honor when Glitterbeam, a global LGBT+ radio station with a presence throughout the UK, took notice of my work on OSTM Radio and asked me to volunteer as a radio presenter with them. It's an incredible opportunity for me to work with such an influential and impactful organization, and I'm thrilled to be able to use my skills and passion for radio to contribute to their mission. I'm excited to see where this partnership might lead and to continue learning and growing as a presenter and media professional.

projects.title: "Innit" - Games Design - Level 3 BTEC (A2)
projects.description: As part of my Level 3 BTEC in Game Design, I had the opportunity to work with a group of talented individuals to create an awesome game. It was a steep learning curve for me, as I had to figure out how to manage a team and work together to meet some tight deadlines to create a fully functional playable demo. But with the support of my teammates and some great guidance from our tutor, we pulled it off, and I gained some valuable experience in teamwork and project management along the way.
